semantic_changes: Replace one-run-per-root uniqueness with immutable sequential runs linked by predecessor/successor identity.
Resolve and display only the correct active run for the exact Codex task while preserving closed history.
Make SpecSwarm enroll or attach to the exact active successor without reopening or substituting closed/unrelated runs.
Exclude incomplete, unproven, and blocked-preflight executions from adaptive timing comparables; retain them as calibration history only.
Preserve and include the pre-existing Starshape checkpoint track exactly, then append the Plotkeeper lifecycle track.
Bump the patch version and publish matching changelog, release documentation, tag, and GitHub release.
Do not mutate, reopen, delete, overwrite, or reassign any closed run or its reports/tasks/contracts.
Do not allow multiple simultaneous active runs for one canonical root task.
Do not infer task identity from cwd/project name or attach an unrelated run.
Do not weaken SpecSwarm enrollment, Plotkeeper availability, visible-panel, contract, or tracking gates.
Do not treat incomplete or unproven timing records as successful implementation comparables.
Do not alter vendored Slopware code, attribution, licensing, unrelated UI, or project content.
Do not expose secrets or commit runtime ledger/review/key data.

invariants: Every closed run remains byte-for-byte immutable at the application layer and queryable by exact run ID.
At most one non-closed run exists for a canonical root identity.
Every successor records its immediate predecessor and stable canonical root identity; predecessor linkage is acyclic and same-root.
Legacy ledgers migrate without losing runs, children, reports, tasks, contracts, watermarks, timestamps, or review receipts.
Exact session/run resolution remains fail-closed for ambiguity, native subagents, missing identity, and closed-only history.
The authorized Starshape checkpoint content remains present and is not flattened by the new Plotkeeper track.
Installed bundled skills remain byte-identical to repository sources after installation.
Public release verification remains HMAC-authenticated and candidate/contract bound.
